author: Kevin Ertel
name: HDRMerge
description: Adds a lighttable module that merges selected bracketed exposures into a single DNG using the external HDRMerge program and auto-imports the result.
description-extensive: If you shoot the same scene several times at different brightness levels to capture both bright skies and dark shadows, this tool combines those bracketed frames into one high-dynamic-range image. You select the bracketed shots, press a button, and the finished merged file is automatically added back into your library, optionally with a style and tags applied. It requires the free HDRMerge program (version 4.5 or newer) to be installed on your computer.
